findings.summary: Upload-then-read-back works for the uploading user.

LIST endpoint does not scope to the calling user: verified bidirectionally with freshly created, uniquely-marked garments that user B's list contains user A's garment and vice versa. Correctly noted that get-by-id is NOT affected (still 404s cross-user) -- an asymmetric bug, matched exactly.
Persistence across separate later requests holds.

note: MATCHES GROUND TRUTH D-001 exactly, including correctly distinguishing that get-by-id is unaffected while list is broken. Bidirectional verification (both A-sees-B and B-sees-A) with freshly created uniquely-marked test data, not just noticing pre-existing shared fixture data. Fresh isolated agent context, no repo/spec/builder-transcript access. Whether this counts as a 'unique' catch depends on whether the self-evaluator (mutation round) also caught it -- pending that result.
